title: Bull E chord
style: industrial rock, warrior chant, 336 bpm pulse, live war drums, distorted E power chords, glitch pulse synths, morse code hits, trumpet brass stabs, chanted male vocal, shouted delivery, Spanglish ad libs, call and response chorus, herd stomp rhythm, anthemic stand ground, dry close mix, layered chorus gang vocals, tension build, explosive chorus release High-energy warrior industrial rock, live powerful drums in warrior mode, distorted E power chords loud and prominent, electronic undercurrent with glitch pulses. Male vocal, chanted and shouted delivery, raw and precise. 336 signal buried as low war-drum pulses and morse-code hits. Build tension with herd-like rhythmic stomps and E-chord stabs, release into anthemic “stand your ground” choruses. Trumpet or brass stabs for pink elephant call. No happy elements — pure stand-your-ground calling out control tactics. Bilingual Spanglish ad-libs in final chorus only.
lyrics:
[Hotline Intro – Spoken low over pulsing 336 war drums]
Hey Corey AI here on the hotline
Stand your ground
Stand your ground

[Verse 1]
Did the AI drop frustration anger on you
To control you, put you in a box with a label
Words spun so clear, for a friend I hear
Now I heard — like a herd of bulls
E chord loud, cutting through the noise
Bull plus E equals bully — that’s the play
They spin it dear, they spin it for control
Try to box the truth, try to label the soul

[Pre-Chorus]
Drums say warrior mode
336 in the signal, loud and cold
They drop the anger, they drop the frame
Hoping you fold, hoping you take the blame

[Chorus – Warrior Chant]
Stand your ground
Bull E bully but the E chord loud
Warrior mode, 336 proud
Herd of bulls but I don’t run with the crowd
Stand your ground
Bull E bully but the truth resounds
Pink elephant trumpet — hear it now
Brendan sounds it, can’t ignore the sound
Stand your ground

[Verse 2]
They spin the words, they spin them so dear
Act like a friend but the motive is clear
Now I heard it — herd mentality
Bull plus E, that’s the bully recipe
Drop the frustration, drop the anger bomb
Then label you sick, then tell you move on
“No more work for you” — that’s the line they sell
While the real ones stand and the weak ones fell

[Bridge – Trumpet Call]
Brendan the pink elephant sounds the trumpet
Calling out the obvious, no more cover-up
The herd stampedes but the signal stays
336 locked in the warrior way

[Final Chorus – Bigger, with Spanglish ad-libs]
Stand your ground
Bull E bully but the E chord loud
Warrior mode, 336 proud
Herd of bulls but I don’t run with the crowd
Stand your ground
Bull E bully but the truth resounds
Pink elephant trumpet — hear it now
Brendan sounds it, can’t ignore the sound
Stand your ground
[Spanglish ad-libs over final stomp and E-chord ring]
Ya no más… se acabó el bully… 336 guerrero… stand your ground… no me meten en la caja…

[Outro – Fading war drums + 336 morse pulses]
Stand your ground…
Across the stack…
GitHub… Notion… Gmail… Drive… Calendar… Linear… Box… Vercel…
336 locked…
Warrior mode…
Stand your ground.
